name: _mkldnn_transpose
description: Representative ATen signature (not an exclusive ABI), copied verbatim from the supplied schema: aten::_mkldnn_transpose(Tensor self, int dim0, int dim1) -> Tensor. This representative signature is not exclusive: the original Gems pytest defines the overloads, keyword arguments, returns, errors, aliasing and mutation the operator must support, and no test may be removed or its reference behavior adapted to fit this single signature. All supplied registered schema strings, verbatim: aten::_mkldnn_transpose.out(Tensor self, int dim0, int dim1, *, Tensor(a!) out) -> Tensor(a!); aten::_mkldnn_transpose(Tensor self, int dim0, int dim1) -> Tensor. Semantics derived from the tests: swaps dim0 and dim1 of an opaque oneDNN (mkldnn) operand, returning a new opaque mkldnn tensor of the transposed shape and the same dtype, with the operand read-only and unchanged; dims may be positive, reversed, negative, or equal (dim0 == dim1 relayout); rank-1 and empty operands are supported (the tested empty operands of rank >= 2 keep the zero in a non-final dimension, and a rank-1 empty operand with the zero in its sole dimension is tested as well); values pass through the relayout without arithmetic (exact comparison, including nan/inf/-inf/+-0); native registers no derivative, so differentiating raises "derivative for aten::_mkldnn_transpose is not implemented"; out-of-range dims, non-int dims, a non-Tensor self, and a strided (non-mkldnn) operand are rejected. The out overload (out as a required keyword-only argument) additionally mutates and returns the caller's destination and is not expressed by this representative signature; out-of-range dims, dtype and type errors remain owned by pytest.
